desc.cn: 为了让干员们适应荒野，克拉拉特意准备了恰到好处的生存训练。
desc.en: Klara has specifically prepared the most suitable survival training to help operators feel at home in the wildlands.

desc.cn: 欢迎回归塔卫二，管理员。
desc.en: Welcome back to Talos-II, Endministrator.

desc.cn: 此时此刻，干员们为您送上了祝福。这些喜悦与温暖，关怀与注视，请您见证。
desc.en: Operators have just sent you their holiday greetings. Witness their joy, warmth, care, and admiration.

desc.cn: 信息开始扩散，文字与声音传递向各方，暂缓旅行的人们，愿各位能重归塔卫二。
desc.en: The notifications are spreading. Text and audio data are being sent to every corner of the world. If you have slowed down your travels, listen to the call that beckons us to return to Talos-II.

desc.cn: 多么伟大的旅程，您已是被选中的长耳兽，万众瞩目，冉冉升起的新星。
desc.en: You are the chosen long-ear, a new rising star idolized by many. This is your epic journey.
